verdict.rationale: Braintrust's own docs say its AI agent Loop can build dashboards, and the product claims real-time tracking of latency, cost, and quality from traces that record latency and token usage. However, there is no documentation of how custom dashboards are configured, what chart types exist, or how metrics are selected. Missing for 10: documentation of custom dashboard building and configuration, explicit error-rate metric charting, explicit eval-score dashboard panels, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics

citations.quote: Ask Braintrust's AI agent to investigate your data and build scorers, datasets, and dashboards
